name: Sinobo Group
verdict: Sinobo Group Co., Ltd. (中赫集团), a privately held Beijing property-and-investment conglomerate owned by Zhou Jinhui and Li Caixia. Nothing found.
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of Beijing Guoan's 2026 home kit (Tencent News, 2026-03-17); sinobo.com/ga lists the club under the group's businesses (a lead, not a checked source). Rating note: ownership documented (claim sinobo-group-ownership). Quick company check (2026-09-30): no court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found. Not claim-worthy: Sinobo Group, the club and Zhou Jinhui face RMB-scale debt-enforcement and dishonest-debtor (失信被执行人) listings (Sohu/ITBEAR, 2025-06-20) — financial matters, which METHOD.md says do not count as a record and are not recorded on a 'none' sponsor.
